before.title: LakeATLAS v1.0 — global lake attributes and pour points
before.description: LakeATLAS lake polygons and pour points with hydro-environmental attributes in separate spatially ordered GeoParquet files, with a versioned field-semantics supplement. Separately versioned PMTiles provide map display for both layers and source-ID attribute lookup.
